Test fonts for tests/test_outline.c (src/outline.c).
All files are generated by tests/gen_outline_fonts.py (python -I tests/gen_outline_fonts.py, needs fontTools) and committed;
the tests never run the script.

NotoSub.ttf
  Subset of assets/fonts/noto-sans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf made with the fontTools subsetter.
  Characters: ABCDHOgaeox0123 .,  U+00E9 (eacute, a composite glyph) and U+00B4; hinting and layout tables dropped.
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt in this directory; Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors).

NotoSub.woff
  The same font saved by fontTools as WOFF (zlib-compressed tables).  Licence: OFL 1.1.

NotoSub.eot
  The same font in an uncompressed EOT, version 0x00020001, the header is built by the script (flags 0).  Licence: OFL 1.1.

NotoSub.xor.eot
  The same EOT with the XOR 0x50 encryption flag (0x10000000) set and the font data XOR-encrypted.  Licence: OFL 1.1.

NotoSub.ttc
  A collection of two faces: the Regular subset above and a subset of NotoSans-Bold.ttf (ABCabc0123 and space).
  Made with fontTools TTCollection.  Licence: OFL 1.1.

NotoSubCff.otf
  OpenType with CFF outlines.
  No small freely licensed CFF font was at hand, so the glyphs of NotoSub.ttf are redrawn as Type 2 charstrings with fontTools
  (T2CharStringPen, quadratic curves raised exactly to cubic) and wrapped by FontBuilder.
  The name table credits Noto Sans and carries the OFL notice.  Licence: OFL 1.1.

UnifontSub.otf
  A real-world CFF font: subset (A B a b 0) of assets/fonts/unifont/unifont-18.0.01.otf made with the fontTools subsetter.
  GNU Unifont is licensed under the GNU GPLv2 or later with the font embedding exception, and the SIL OFL 1.1
  (see assets/fonts/unifont/COPYING and OFL-1.1.txt).

NotoSub.pfb
  A Type 1 font written by the script (no third-party Type 1 file was used: the sample in pixelglyphlib has no stated licence).
  The outlines are those of NotoSub.ttf as cubic charstrings (reversed to counter-clockwise), encrypted as PFB (eexec 55665,
  charstrings 4330, lenIV 4), with five Subrs (standard flex Subrs 0-3 and one hint Subr), a custom Encoding array
  (code 126 -> foo), a seac composite (eacute = e + acute), and four hand made glyphs:
  uni25A0 a rectangle whose bottom edge is a flex (area 500 x 700 units), u25A1 the same rectangle with hint replacement,
  foo a triangle (area 175000 units^2), and .notdef.
  Licence: OFL 1.1 for the outlines taken from Noto Sans; the rest is generated by the script.

OFL.txt
  Copy of assets/fonts/noto-sans/OFL.txt.

PixelSquare.ttf, PixelShift.ttf, PixelDots.ttf, pixel_glyphs.txt
  Pixel fonts drawn with outlines, for tests/test_fit.c (src/fit.c) and the end-to-end scripts 101 and 102.
  Generated by tests/gen_pixel_fonts.py (python -I tests/gen_pixel_fonts.py, needs fontTools) and committed.
  33 glyphs of a hand-made 5 x 7 design with two rows below the baseline, and a space; 1000 units per em, a pixel is 100 units.
  PixelSquare: every run of pixels is a rectangle on the grid.
  PixelShift: the grid is shifted by (30, -20) units and the pixels are 104 x 96 units large, so no common divisor tells the grid.
  PixelDots: every pixel is a separate diamond of 80 units.
  pixel_glyphs.txt holds the bitmaps the fonts were drawn from (code point, then 9 rows of 5 pixels).
  Licence: public domain (CC0 1.0); no font file was copied.
